question: Which further candidates are proposed as valid cognition?
premises: Some followers of Paramarshi call the collection of its modifications valid cognition.
Others identify valid cognition with the class of properties counted as eight beginning with merit.
Both views shift valid cognition away from a single simple locus.
inference: Different schools treat either mental modifications or a set of properties as the basis of valid cognition.
uncertainties: The antecedent of 'its modifications' is not explicit in this verse and depends on the preceding discussion.
plain_english: Some followers of Paramarshi say valid cognition is the collection of its modifications, while others hold it to be the class of properties counted as eight, beginning with merit.
